summary: This Form 6-K reports two routine corporate actions by Pelagos Insurance Capital Ltd (formerly Fidelis Insurance Holdings): the legal effectiveness of a rebranding and name change, and a corresponding NYSE ticker symbol change to PLGO. No transaction, stakeholder activism, strategic review, or other special situation is described. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer notification of a name and ticker change that was previously approved by shareholders at an AGM. All business operations, strategy, and management remain unchanged. No deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angles apply; this is purely administrative.
